instruction: Open-choice CLI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering toolchains, including BIM-capable tools and a distractor tool. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable command-line or official automation workflow from these options to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and export the completed IFC4 deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected BIM toolchain. The current model is a small two-level public library with a ground-floor reading area and a first-floor gallery below a simple roof. Library staff want two small bookable quiet pods added near the existing first-floor study rooms, while keeping the stair, roof geometry, and main open reading areas intact. Add the quiet pod records and make their purpose clear for the booking schedule.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
